summary: {spouse} completes a separate account of the conversations a household is having trouble hearing.
realLife: In a Pittsburgh case report, a retiree and his spouse answered parallel questions independently. Before he used the aids, she reported more difficulty overall than he did. Both recorded improvement at follow-up.
inGame: needs: separate household accounts and dates of follow-up.

turns.pulledBy: Both people agree to share their answers.
turns.what: The caseworker records who noticed each difficulty.
turns.writesBack: A later check can ask each person about the same situations.

turns.pulledBy: Only the wearer wants to speak.
turns.what: Staff takes the account the wearer volunteers.
turns.writesBack: The file leaves the spouse’s view open.
